name: Keslr Connect
tagline: Sign in with Keslr — proving you are a real vouched human
description: Keslr Connect is a "Sign in with Keslr" primitive that issues verification claims proving a user is a real, vouched human. It is a new building block for anti-bot systems: instead of CAPTCHAs or fragile heuristics, it leans on a social-vouching graph to establish that an account belongs to a genuine person. For platforms fighting automation, spam, and synthetic accounts, it offers a lightweight identity layer that agents and bots should not be able to pass.
highlights: A verification-claim primitive that establishes real, vouched humanity
Purpose-built to be a building block for anti-bot and anti-spam systems
Social-vouching model sidesteps CAPTCHAs and fragile heuristics
A clean, embeddable 'Sign in with Keslr' flow for developers
curatorNote: Bot detection keeps chasing the same arms race, and Keslr Connect offers something genuinely different: a vouched-human primitive rather than another heuristic. Early, but it is the kind of identity primitive that could quietly become infrastructure.
